business_problem: Dojo is a UK-based payments provider that specializes in fast, secure in-person and online card processing for businesses. The company's journey is rooted in a desire to break free from the limitations of legacy systems.
solution_summary: Rather than incrementally improving outdated systems, Dojo built a fully cloud-native payments platform from the ground up on the Google Cloud. "We started by asking, ‘how do we give our customers features, service, and capabilities at the pace they deserve?,'" says Howes. "We felt the way to do that was to take full control of the entire acquiring payments stack, in a purely cloud-native way. At the core of Dojo's platform is Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) , which powers thousands of workloads across the business, from transaction processing to internal tools. This containerized architecture enables rapid scaling, allowing the platform to handle spikes in demand without compromising performance. The Dojo transaction processing system also relies on Spanner , which delivers strongly consistent, globally distributed transactions at scale and enables Dojo to process payments with exceptional speed and reliability.
